goal: 50 v2 high-quality One Life Relay stages

stages.title: 불뗏목
stages.description: 용암 강 위에서 간헐천을 피해 관문을 통과하는 뗏목.
stages.controls: 화면 좌우 드래그 또는 방향키로 조타
stages.mechanic: Third-person raft on a flowing lava river. Lateral steering. Geysers telegraph 0.7s then erupt. Gates are stone arches ahead. Camera behind-and-above.

stages.title: 석영 광차
stages.description: 분기 선로를 바꿔 석영 금고까지 광차를 이끄세요.
stages.mechanic: On-rails minecart. Upcoming junction highlighted. Tap toggles left/right switch before the fork. Wrong fork = void. Camera chase along track.

stages.title: 서리 스키프
stages.description: 맞바람을 타고 유빙 부표를 도는 빙상 세일링.
stages.mechanic: Skiff speed depends on sail vs wind angle. Tacking required to reach upwind buoys. Ice ridges as hazards. Side camera, low over ice.

stages.title: 사구 스키머
stages.description: 모래고래를 피해 오아시스 결정을 줍는 호버크래프트.
stages.mechanic: Hovercraft with inertia over rolling dunes. Sand whales breach along predicted ridges. Tokens hover in oasis bowls. Chase camera.

stages.title: 산호 잠수정
stages.description: 부력을 조절해 산호 고리를 통과하는 잠수정.
stages.controls: 위아래 드래그 또는 W/S로 부력, 좌우로 선회
stages.mechanic: Sub has ballast (vertical velocity). Hold up/down to fill/vent. Coral rings drift with current. Caustic lighting. Follow camera in water fog.

stages.title: 혜성 그물
stages.description: 밤하늘에서 떨어지는 혜성을 그물로 받아내세요.
stages.failCondition: 놓친 혜성 4개 또는 도시 피격 시 실패
stages.mechanic: Top-down-ish rooftop. Comets have visible trails and impact lead markers. Move a wide net. City below takes damage if comet lands. Camera high looking down-forward.

stages.title: 낙뢰 막대
stages.description: 벼락이 치기 전 피뢰침을 꽂아 전하를 받으세요.
stages.mechanic: Storm plateau. Clouds telegraph strike points 1.1s ahead. Tap to plant a rod with limited count (recycle). Camera orbit looking across mesa.

stages.title: 프리즘 반사
stages.description: 프리즘을 돌려 빛줄기를 성소 핵까지 이으세요.
stages.mechanic: 4 rotatable prisms in a dark hall. Beam reflects with visible path. Wrong angle leaks into void (strike). Align all to crystal core. Camera slightly elevated isometric 3D.

stages.title: 절벽 파종
stages.description: 움직이는 절벽 선반에 씨앗을 심는 공성 파종기.
stages.mechanic: Ballistic arc with gravity. Ledges slide horizontally. Lead the moving target. Bloom on successful plant. Side-3/4 camera.

stages.title: 유리 화살
stages.description: 바람에 흔들리는 색유리 구멍을 꿰뚫는 활.
stages.mechanic: Cathedral interior. Stained-glass windows sway in wind (holes move). Arrow affected by lateral wind. Hitting glass (not hole) fails. First-person-ish over-shoulder.

stages.title: 담금질
stages.description: 잉곳이 알맞은 색일 때 내려치는 대장간.
stages.mechanic: Ingot color cycles cold-blue → gold → white-hot. Strike only in gold window. Hammer animation, sparks, anvil camera close 3D. Heat bar HUD.

stages.title: 만조 종
stages.description: 파도가 종에 닿는 순간 타종하는 방파제.
stages.mechanic: 3 hanging bells over a pier. Waves of different heights hit different bells. Telegraph foam. Ring the bell that the wave will kiss. Side camera, ocean shader-ish meshes.

stages.title: 베틀 북
stages.description: 오가는 날실 틈으로 북을 통과시키는 베틀.
stages.mechanic: Warp threads open/close in patterns. Launch shuttle when a lane is open. Close-up 3D loom with moving heddles. Camera locked on loom throat.

stages.title: 가마 공전
stages.description: 유약이 한쪽으로 쏠리지 않게 가마를 돌리세요.
stages.mechanic: Pot on a rotating kiln. Gravity pulls glaze. Keep highlight band even by counter-rotating. Overheat zones appear. Close studio camera.

stages.title: 간헐천 북
stages.description: 간헐천이 솟는 북을 순서대로 치세요.
stages.mechanic: 4 stone drums in a geothermal circle. Steam telegraph then geyser. Hit the erupting drum. Camera slightly above circle.

stages.title: 아틀라스 구
stages.description: 무너지는 유적 길을 구체를 굴려 통과하세요.
stages.mechanic: Physics marble on crumbling platforms. Tilt control. Falling columns telegraph. Follow camera, marble in foreground.

stages.title: 극성 크레인
stages.description: N/S 극성으로 화물을 집어 부두에 쌓으세요.
stages.controls: 드래그로 크레인 이동, 탭으로 극성 전환
stages.mechanic: Overhead crane. Crates marked N or S. Magnet polarity must match to pick, opposite to drop onto matching pad. Clash explodes. Top-down 3D dock.

stages.title: 빙핵 시추
stages.description: 회전하는 빙핵을 깨지 않게 수직으로 시추하세요.
stages.mechanic: Core spins and drifts. Hold to drill; off-center increases crack meter. Extract at depth 100%. Close-up rig camera.

stages.title: 비단 다리
stages.description: 바람에 버티며 협곡에 비단 다리를 잇으세요.
stages.mechanic: Anchor silk points on opposite cliffs in sequence. Gusts tug the strand (tension meter). Too much slack or snap fails. Cinematic canyon camera.

stages.title: 자이로 성채
stages.description: 팽이가 쓰러지지 않게 성벽을 건너세요.
stages.mechanic: Player carries a spinning gyro. Path has bumps that add tilt. Counter-steer. Narrow battlements. Third-person behind.

stages.title: 포자 금고
stages.description: 포자 구름을 피해 온실 난초를 모으세요.
stages.controls: 드래그 또는 WASD로 이동, 탭으로 대시
stages.mechanic: Lush greenhouse. Spore clouds expand then drift. Dash has cooldown. Orchids on raised planters. Interior 3D camera.

stages.title: 균열 스케이트
stages.description: 갈라지는 빙하 균열 위를 건너 반대편으로.
stages.mechanic: Forward auto-skate. Rift opens in patterns. Jump over gaps. Camera behind, looking down the crevasse.

stages.title: 화산재 능선
stages.description: 무너지는 지붕을 달려 굴뚝 불씨를 지키세요.
stages.mechanic: Side-forward rooftop runner in 3D. Tiles collapse behind. Ash columns block. Collect chimney embers. Chase camera.

stages.title: 수정 바늘골
stages.description: 우산으로 수정 바늘을 막으며 협곡을 내려가세요.
stages.mechanic: Descent with gravity. Needles rain from canyon walls. Held umbrella blocks above but slows fall. Camera above-behind.

stages.title: 박쥐 음파
stages.description: 음파로 동굴을 읽고 나방을 사냥하세요.
stages.mechanic: Dark cave. Geometry mostly unlit until sonar ping reveals for 0.8s. Moths glow faintly. Fly with drag. Camera behind bat.

stages.title: 반딧불 우물
stages.description: 반딧불을 등롱 안으로 몰아넣는 우물 정원.
stages.mechanic: Fireflies attracted to a movable lamp, wander if too fast. Guide into well lantern. Wind gusts scatter. Night garden camera above well.

stages.title: 잉어 물길
stages.description: 물길을 열어 잉어를 연못 문으로 이끄세요.
stages.mechanic: Garden canal with gates that redirect current. Koi follow flow. Predatory current drains. Top-down 3D water garden.

stages.title: 별 목동
stages.description: 떠도는 별을 별자리 홈에 밀어 넣으세요.
stages.mechanic: Floating starfield. Stars have inertia. Constellation sockets glow. Push too hard and they escape the plane. Camera looking up into sky dome.

stages.title: 꽃가루 길
stages.description: 벌을 피해 꽃가루 구름을 거두세요.
stages.mechanic: Meadow corridor. Pollen motes drift. Bees patrol flowers and chase if close. Soft third-person.

stages.title: 불나방 등
stages.description: 등불을 옮겨 나방을 안전한 숲 문으로 이끄세요.
stages.mechanic: Moths follow lamp. Too close + high brightness burns them. Wind threatens flame (tap to cup). Forest night camera.

stages.title: 톱니 맞물림
stages.description: 날아가는 톱니를 시계 축에 맞춰 끼우세요.
stages.mechanic: Launch gears onto spinning shafts. Size/timing must mesh. Jam meter. Clock tower interior, brass materials.

stages.title: 태양 거울
stages.description: 거울을 돌려 성소 안쪽까지 햇살을 이으세요.
stages.mechanic: Desert temple. 4 steerable mirrors. Sun beam path visible. Overheat if beam hits sand too long. Elevated 3D.

stages.title: 운하 수문
stages.description: 수위를 맞춰 화물선을 세 수문으로 통과시키세요.
stages.mechanic: Barge auto-moves when water levels match. Open/close gates, pump up/down. Flood or dry-dock fails. Side 3D canal.

stages.title: 테세라 낙하
stages.description: 떨어지는 타일을 모자이크 자리에 받아 끼우세요.
stages.mechanic: Tiles fall with color/shape. Move a catcher over matching mosaic sockets. Byzantine interior. Camera looking down a wall.

stages.title: 룬 인장
stages.description: 지나가는 석판에 맞는 룬을 찍으세요.
stages.mechanic: Conveyor of stone tablets with ghost runes. 3 stamp heads. Timing window. Workshop camera.

stages.title: 고래 숨결
stages.description: 고래 숨기둥을 타고 용연향을 줍는 해상 활강.
stages.mechanic: Hang on a cloak. Whale surfaces and blows; ride the column. Distinct from hang glider: vertical burst locomotion between whales. Ocean camera.

stages.title: 파이프 비행
stages.description: 열리고 닫히는 오르간 파이프 속을 날아 통과하세요.
stages.mechanic: Giant cathedral organ. Pipes open on notes then slam. Fly a lantern through open bores. Camera inside brass tunnels.

stages.title: 모래시계 등반
stages.description: 빠져나가는 모래보다 빨리 위 방으로 오르세요.
stages.mechanic: Inside a giant hourglass. Sand level falls (and sometimes surges). Platforms are glass ribs. Camera inside glass looking up.

stages.title: 극광 연
stages.description: 오로라 리본을 가로지르며 연을 조종하세요.
stages.mechanic: Kite on a string from a cliff. Tension + angle. Aurora ribbons drift. Distinct from aurora-harpoon (no shooting) and solstice-glider (you are the kite, not a glider). Camera from cliff looking out.

stages.title: 마그마 곤돌라
stages.description: 화산 호수 위 곤돌라에서 방해 줄을 잘라 건너세요.
stages.mechanic: Gondola auto-travels. Sway from magma bursts. Cut falling hazard ropes before they snag. Balance to not tip. Side 3D caldera.

stages.title: 바람 등롱
stages.description: 바람을 막아 등불을 사당까지 운반하세요.
stages.mechanic: Carry lantern. Gusts from canyons. Hold to shield (slows walk). Flame meter. Third-person mountain path. Distinct from moth-lamp (you escort, moths don't exist).

stages.title: 산호 합창
stages.description: 울리는 산호로 헤엄쳐 화음을 맞추세요.
stages.mechanic: Coral clusters pulse a target pitch. Swim into the matching glowing coral in time. Wrong coral = dissonance stun toward rocks. Underwater camera.

stages.title: 폭풍 닻
stages.description: 흔들리는 배에서 닻을 정확한 암초에 내리세요.
stages.mechanic: Deck pitches. Aim anchor at glowing reef rings. Miss increases drift. Ship wrecks if drift max. Deck camera in storm.

stages.title: 종이학 상승
stages.description: 접힌 날개를 펴 상승기류로 종이학을 올리세요.
stages.mechanic: NOT hang gliding. Tap to unfold/fold wings (glide vs dive). Thermals marked by petals. Overfold tears. City rooftop sky. Distinct from solstice-glider.

stages.title: 공허 고리
stages.description: 회전하는 공허 고리 사이로 탐사선을 꿰세요.
stages.mechanic: Ship flies forward. Rings rotate and translate. Tight threading. Distinct from ion-sling (no gravity sling, it's aperture flying). Space camera chase.
